title: "Publications"
subtitle: "Selected papers where the team holds a signing author position"
toc: true
toc-depth: 2
---

Papers from **2019–2026** that meet two conditions at once:

- published in a journal with an **impact factor above 10**, and
- with an L2IB member as **first, second, second-to-last or last author**.

That second condition is what separates the team's own work from the large
multicentre trials it also contributes to.

[Show all publications](publications-all.qmd){.btn-app .btn-launch}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## How this list is built

For **2019–2024**, the starting point is the team's HCERES bibliographic
record: 19 per-member sheets, 648 rows, 480 distinct publications after
deduplication. **Author position** is computed by locating each member in the
author string of their own record, accounting for co-first and co-last author
markers.

For **2025–2026**, references come from a PubMed search across team members
with a Lyon affiliation, filtered the same way.

**Impact factor** is not a column in the HCERES record, so the filter is
applied to the journal name through a lookup table based on recent JCR values.
Journals just below the cut, and therefore absent from this page but present in
the full list: *Haematologica* (8.2), *HemaSphere* (7.6), *Blood Advances*
(7.4), *eClinicalMedicine* (9.6), *PNAS* (9.4).

Titles, author lists, PMIDs and DOIs come from **PubMed**, not from the source
spreadsheet, so they carry the publisher's canonical wording.

One qualifying publication was left out as outside the team's research scope: a
*Molecular Biology and Evolution* phylogeny of semi-aquatic bugs, from a team
member's earlier career in evolutionary biology.
:::
